Commentary.Commentary: Right then! That is it from the coverage of game number 18. The action from the Women's World Cup continues and it is New Zealand Women who will be taking on England Women on Sunday, 20th March at Eden Park, Auckland. This promises to be a cracker of a contest as both sides will be going hard at each other in order to stay in contention for semi-finals. The first ball will be bowled at 3.30 am IST (10 pm GMT, previous night) but you can tune in early for the build-up. Cheers and goodbye!

Meg Lanning, the skipper of Australia Women, starts by saying that India are a very good team and they have some world-class players. Tells that they still need to improve in some areas as they didn't field well in this game. Mentions that Eden Park is unique ground and they need to adjust quickly. Mentions that Rachael Haynes and Alyssa Healy got them off to a great start and laid a good foundation. Says that it is nice to see Alyssa Healy doing well and applauds her for the way she batted in this fixture.

Mithali Raj the skipper of India Women, says that whenever they lose, they feel, they fell short by 10-15 runs, but the way Australia started the innings, they were always ahead of the asking rate. Mentions that the bowling unit did not do well this time around, but they have done well in the previous games. States that the batting has improved from earlier on, but the bowling took a hit today, they have two games left and they will look to do well in all three departments. On Jhulan Goswami, she says that Jhulan is an inspiration for many girls. She concludes by thanking all the fans who came and supported them at Eden Park.

Meg Lanning is the PLAYER OF THE MATCH. She says that it is nice to contribute and she has been training hard in the nets. Tells that it was a good wicket to bat on and says that she had a clear game plan against the Indian bowlers. Mentions that she has a different game plan as compared to Ellyse Perry but says that she enjoys batting with her.
Stay tuned for the presentation...

Tough day for the Women in Blue! Their batting was the concern earlier on, but in this game, it was their bowling that has let them down. The batters did step up today as they posted a healthy total of 277, but it was not enough in the end. The ball was not gripping enough, which was tough for the Indian spinners, also they were without their sixth bowling option today, Deepti Sharma, which would hurt them in hindsight. India Women were put on the back foot earlier on in the innings by the Aussie openers. They did come back into this game by grabbing two quick wickets, but they could not capitalize on the same and let Australia Women get away with another partnership. Meghna Singh did grab the important wicket of Meg Lanning but it was a little too late by then. India Women will have to win their remaining games to brighten their chances of making it to the semi-final.

Australia Women started scoring runs right from the word go. Alyssa Healy and Rachael Haynes put up 121 runs together within the first 20 overs of the innings and got them to a flying start. But Alyssa Healy perished after scoring a sublime 72 and Rachael Haynes followed her soon. After losing both the openers, skipper, Meg Lanning and Ellyse Perry once again started scoring runs freely and they put together over 100 runs, before Perry was dismissed. Meg Lanning carried on, and was dismissed for 97! She did miss out on a well-deserved century, but she guided her side closer to victory. Beth Mooney finished things off in the final over to get her side over the line! Australia Women have sealed a spot in the semi-final and have also registered their highest successful run chase in Women's World Cup history.

Australia Women, the mighty Australians, have done it yet again! They are making a habit of winning! Their domination in this World Cup continues, and with this win, they become the first team to qualify for the semi-finals! So, another game in this Women's World cup that has gone to the final over. The Aussies kept their cool and have chased the target down. India Women, on the other hand, suffer their second loss on the trot. Things are only getting tougher for them in this race for a semi-final spot.

FOUR! There it is! Mooney seals the deal for Australia Women! Goswami serves a full ball, on middle. Mooney sits back and lofts it over the bowler's head. The ball races away to the fence. Australia Women win the match by 6 wickets!
Fuller in length, on off. Mooney carves it through covers. Smriti Mandhana runs in from the deep and she fumbles while trying to grab the ball. The batters collect two runs in total.
FOUR! UP AND OVER! What pressure? says Mooney! This is a length ball, on middle. Beth Mooney clears her front leg and whacks it over mid-wicket for a boundary.
Jhulan Goswami in her 200th ODI will bowl the final over. Can she defend this?
Two dots in a row and the game is far from over! Singh serves it full and well outside off. Tahlia McGrath shuffles across and slices it straight to the point fielder. 8 runs needed off 6 balls.
Back of a length, outside off. Tahlia McGrath defends it to cover.
Tahlia McGrath comes to bat now.

OUT! TAKEN! Lanning misses out on her hundred and this is a big wicket for India Women. They believe! Singh serves a full ball, outside off. Lanning opens the bat face and looks to drive but it goes off the outer half of the bat towards Pooja Vastrakar at point, who dives in front and takes a really good catch. End of a brilliant innings from Australia's skipper, she walks back to the hut after scoring 97 runs off 107 balls.
Commentary.Howout: c Pooja Vastrakar b Meghna Singh

Commentary.Commentary: Singh goes full and outside off. Mooney drives it to the extra cover fielder who half-stops it and the batters cross ends.
Back of a length, on middle. Lanning swivels and pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a run.
A full ball, outside off. Beth Mooney drives it through the cover region and hands the strike to her skipper.
Make that four in a row! Fuller in length, outside off. Meg Lanning drives it to the fielder at extra cover.
Three dots in a row! Another ball, on a length and outside off. Lanning cuts hard but finds the backward point fielder this time.
Cut hard but for no run! Shorter in length, outside off. Lanning cuts it straight to the point fielder.
On a length, around off. Lanning keeps it out.

Slashed hard but for just two runs! Back of a length, yet again, outside off. Lanning stays back and just eases it past the diving fielder at backward point. The fielder at third man does well to save the boundary.
Back of a length, outside off. Lanning tries to cut hard but fails to get any bat on it.
A direct hit at the striker's end but Mooney was home! Fuller in length, around off. Lanning defends it towards cover and sets off for a single. 13 runs needed off 18 balls.
Back of a length, around off. Meg Lanning taps it towards backward point.
On a length, around middle. Beth Mooney nudges it to the leg side and settles for a single.
FOUR! Excellent timing from Mooney! This is a full ball, outside off. Mooney just opens the bat face and slices it wide of the third man fielder for a boundary.
Back of a length, outside off. Lanning cuts it towards wide third man for a run.
A full ball, outside off. Beth Mooney comes down the track and carves it to deep cover for a single.
FOUR! Cut away nicely! Just a tad short, outside off. Lanning stays low and cuts it hard past the point fielder to bag another boundary. She moves to 92 now! 21 runs needed off 24 balls.
Back of a length, outside off. Mooney guides it to third man for one run.
Goswami goes full and around off. Mooney drags it towards mid on. No run there!
Slightly shorter in length, outside off. Meg Lanning gets low in her crease and cuts it past point for a run.
Mooney gets down the track and drives this full ball towards mid off for a quick single.
This is a length ball, around off. Lanning stays back and steers it to third man for a single.
Jhulan Goswami (7-0-44-0) comes back to bowl.
Pitches it up again, outside off. Meg Lanning drives it past cover for a single. Australia Women need 29 runs off 30 balls!
Loopy ball, full, around off. Meg Lanning leans and defends it out.
Fuller ball, on middle. Beth Mooney steps down the pitch and lifts it over the bowler's head for a single.
Shorter now, outside off. Beth Mooney punches it towards sweeper cover for a brace.
FOUR! Beth Mooney takes on Rajeshwari Gayakwad! This one was very full, on middle, much slower through the air. Beth Mooney gets down her knee and sweeps it towards deep mid-wicket for a boundary.
Loopy ball, full, on middle. Beth Mooney blocks it out.
FOUR! Top shot! Fuller, wide of off. Meg Lanning stays back and slashes this past point for a boundary. This is trademark Meg Lanning!
On a length, outside off. Beth Mooney pushes it towards point for a single.
Shorter now, wide of off. Meg Lanning cuts it towards sweeper cover for a single.
Fuller ball, around middle. Meg Lanning pushes it back to the bowler.
Fuller delivery now, on middle. Beth Mooney knocks it towards mid on and scampers through to the other end.
On a length, outside off. Meg Lanning taps it towards point for a single.
Tad quicker, full again, around middle. Beth Mooney miscues her flick towards square leg. Tidy over, just 2 runs off it.
Loopy ball, very full again, on middle. Beth Mooney drives it towards mid off.
Tad fuller, outside off. Meg Lanning punches it towards extra cover. A quick single taken!
Slower through the air, very full, on middle. Meg Lanning drives this towards cover.
Tad shorter, outside off. Meg Lanning miscues her shot towards cover-point.
Well bowled! A loopy ball, full, spinning away, outside off. Meg Lanning leans to drive, but she misses as the ball spins away from her.
Full and outside off. Lanning drives it to deep cover and takes a single.
FOUR! WHACKED! A short ball that sits up nicely for Lanning, around off. She pulls it in front of square on the leg side and bags a boundary.
Length ball, angling in, on the pads. Beth Mooney tucks it towards fine leg for a single.
Beth Mooney walks out to bat.

OUT! CAUGHT! India Women have finally managed to break this partnership! Pooja Vastrakar strikes and gets rid of the dangerous, Ellyse Perry. They have their third wicket! Ellyse Perry will be gutted on missing out on a full toss, but Pooja Vastrakar gets lucky! A full toss, outside off. Ellyse Perry stays in the crease and pushes it towards cover. The ball goes off the bottom of the bat and lobs up towards Mithali Raj at cover. She pouches it safely!
Commentary.Howout: c Mithali Raj b Pooja Vastrakar

Commentary.Commentary: Is that a fair ball? The umpire is checking whether the ball was below the waist of Perry. The replays roll in and it shows that it was a fair ball as it well-below the waist. Perry is a goner!
Pitches it up again, on middle. Ellyse Perry pushes it to mid on this time.
Fuller now, around off. Ellyse Perry drives and finds the fielder at mid off.
Wide! On a length, down the leg side. Ellyse Perry misses her flick and wide called.
The players have made their way out in the middle. Ellyse Perry and Meg Lanning to resume their innings. Pooja Vastrakar will start with the ball. Let's go!
UPDATE - 1.25 pm IST (7.55 am GMT) - We have a good news, folks! The rain has stopped. The groundstaff are taking the covers off. The play will resume at 1.35 pm IST (8.05 am GMT).

UPDATE - 1.15 pm IST (7.45 am GMT) -  All of a sudden, it has started to rain and the groundstaff come out with the covers. The DLS par score after 41 overs is 197, so Australia Women are well-ahead by 28 runs. We hope that this is nothing more than a passing shower and the action resumes soon, as only the pitch is covered at the moment. Stay tuned for further updates.

Much fuller this time, on middle, loopy delivery. Meg Lanning drives it towards cover.

Short of a length, angling in from outside off. Meg Lanning looks to cut but gets cramped for room and the ball dabs onto the deck.
Back of a length, around off. Meg Lanning taps it towards backward point.

Good-length ball, outside off. Meg Lanning dabs it towards third man and takes a single.

On a length, around off. Ellyse Perry pushes it towards cover.

Back of a length, outside off. Meg Lanning dabs it towards point for a single.
On a length, angling in, around middle. Meg Lanning looks to flick, but she misses and gets rapped on the pads.

On a length, outside off. Ellyse Perry dabs it towards third man and rotates the strike!
Tad shorter now, around middle. Meg Lanning pulls it towards deep square leg for a brace. India Women will need a wicket! It's all too easy for Australia Women at the moment!
Fuller ball, spinning back in, around middle. Ellyse Perry steps down and flicks it towards square leg for a single.

Quicker, on middle, fuller ball. Meg Lanning flicks this towards deep square leg. A little fumble there by the fielder allows the batters to complete two runs. That will be 50 for the Australian skipper!
Fuller ball, on middle. Meg Lanning leans and blocks it out.
Full again, around middle. Ellyse Perry pushes it towards mid on.
Good-length delivery, around off. Ellyse Perry drives it towards mid on.
Fuller ball, wide of off. Meg Lanning drives it towards sweeper cover for a boundary.

On a length, outside off. Ellyse Perry taps it towards cover-point for a single.
Jhulan Goswami (3-0-22-0) comes back to bowl. Can she provide her team with the much-needed breakthrough?

FOUR! Another boundary of the over! India Women cannot afford these! Shorter ball, around middle. Meg Lanning pulls it, but the ball goes off the top edge towards square leg for a boundary. 12 runs off the over!
Wide of off, tad fuller. Ellyse Perry cuts it towards deep point for a single.

Good-length delivery, outside off. Meg Lanning dabs it towards third man for a single.
FOUR! Punished! On a length, wide of off. Meg Lanning reaches out to it and slashes it past Rajeshwari Gayakwad at cover-point for a cracking boundary. 50-run stand comes up between these two!
Well bowled! Yorker-length delivery, outside off. Meg Lanning digs it out.
On a length, outside off. Ellyse Perry guides it towards third man and rotates the strike.
Meghna Singh (7-0-45-0) is back on.
Darting this on the pads, fuller ball. Meg Lanning clips it towards square leg.
Flatter, quicker, around middle and leg. Ellyse Perry works it away towards mid-wicket for a single.
Tosses it up, full, around off. Meg Lanning drives it towards long off for another single.
Tad quicker, around middle and leg. Meg Lanning hangs back and defends it out.
FOUR! Top shot! Another pitched up delivery, on middle. Meg Lanning gets down on her knee and sweeps it towards deep square leg. The ball goes one bounce and over the ropes for a boundary!
Slower through the air, very full, outside off. Ellyse Perry knocks it wide of long off for a single.
Flighted delivery, around off. Meg Lanning gets to the pitch of the ball and defends it. 114 runs needed off 120 balls.
Perry skips down the track and eases this full ball to long off for a single.
Tossed up, outside off. Ellyse Perry keeps it out on the off side.
Slightly shorter in length, outside off and turning away late. Ellyse Perry hangs back and taps it towards short third man.
On a length and outside off. Meg Lanning pushes it wide of the cover fielder and takes a single.
Tosses it up, outside off. Meg Lanning drives but finds the cover fielder.

DRINKS! India Women have done well to send both the openers back to the hut. But Australia Women are still cruising along nicely. India Women will need quick wickets to put Australia Women under pressure.
A slight fumble and that allows the batters to sneak in a single. This is a quicker ball, on a length, outside off. Lanning taps it towards point and Lanning retains the strike by collecting a run.
Tosses it up, outside off. Meg Lanning gets forward and blocks it out.
An arm ball, on a length, around off. Meg Lanning defends it out, on the back foot.
FOUR! Slightly shorter in length, outside off and Lanning punishes it! She rocks back in her crease and cuts it past the diving fielder at short third man for a boundary.
Full and on middle. Ellyse Perry skips down the track and drives it down to long on for one run.
A quicker ball, on middle. Perry gets back in her crease and tucks it to mid-wicket.
BEAUTY! A loopy ball, on a length, outside off and turning away just that little bit. Meg Lanning prods to defend but the ball beats her outside edge.
Flatter ball, on a length, around middle. Meg Lanning defends it back to the bowler.
Tosses it up, well outside off. Ellyse Perry gets to the pitch of the ball and eases it to sweeper cover for a run.
Floated, full and outside off. Ellyse Perry pushes it towards cover-point.
Shorter in length, outside off. Lanning cuts it to sweeper cover and takes a run.
Slower through the air, around off. Meg Lanning keeps it out.
Good-length ball, on middle. Ellyse Perry pushes it back to the bowler. A productive over for Australia Women, 10 runs came off it!
On a length, around middle and leg. Meg Lanning nudges it around the corner and rotates the strike.
Good-length delivery, around off. Meg Lanning taps it towards backward point.

Back of a length, around middle. Ellyse Perry tucks it to deep mid-wicket and takes a single.

Flighted delivery, on a length, just outside off. Meg Lanning prods to block it out.
Floated, full and outside off. Meg Lanning prods and drives it to the cover fielder.

Perry rocks back to this loopy, full ball and cuts it straight to the fielder at cover-point.
Slightly shorter in length, outside off. Ellyse Perry cuts it straight to the point fielder.
Flatter ball, on a length, outside off. Meg Lanning cuts it to deep cover and takes a single.

Fuller length delivery, around middle. Ellyse Perry pushes it back to the bowler. Pooja Vastrakar collects the ball and has a shy at the striker's end, but she misses. Ellyse Perry does well to drag her back foot back in the crease.
Very full now, around middle. Meg Lanning squeezes it towards point for a single.
Good-length delivery, outside off. Meg Lanning defends it out.

Wide! Pooja Vastrakar drops it short now, outside off. Meg Lanning leaves it alone. Wide called!
On a length, outside the off pole. Ellyse Perry pushes it towards third man and rotates the strike!

Flighted ball, full again, around middle. Meg Lanning has defended this off the front foot.

Tosses it up, full, around middle. Meg Lanning defends it out.
Fuller again, around middle and leg. Ellyse Perry hangs back and tucks it towards square leg and rotates the strike.
Slower through the air, tad fuller, outside off. Ellyse Perry pushes it towards cover off the back foot.
Shorter ball, around middle. Meg Lanning stays in her crease and pulls it past square leg for a single.
Fuller ball, around middle. Ellyse Perry drives it with the inner half of her bat towards mid on.
Angling in, around off, on a length. Meg Lanning looks to defend this but the ball goes off the outside edge towards third man. Single taken!
Touch fuller, outside off. Meg Lanning drives it towards cover-point. The fielder there fails to stop the ball, which allows the batters to take two easy runs.
Good-length delivery, outside off. Meg Lanning defends it out.
On a length, outside off. Ellyse Perry pushes it towards third man and rotates the strike. She gets off the mark with that!
A low full toss ball, around off. Ellyse Perry drives it towards mid off.
Loopy delivery, full again, on middle. Meg Lanning blocks it out.
Touch shorter, outside off. Meg Lanning stays back and cuts it towards point. Not in the gap though!
Full in length, on middle. Meg Lanning leans and defends it out.

Very full again, around off. Meg Lanning defends it out.

Ellyse Perry walks in at number 4.

OUT!  CAUGHT BEHIND! Pooja Vastrakar strikes and gets rid of Rachael Haynes! Just what India Women needed. Another set batter goes back now! Australia Women lose their second wicket. Pooja Vastrakar drops this one short, around middle. Rachael Haynes looks to pull this, but she gets a faint edge towards the keeper. Richa Ghosh takes a sharp catch. India Women back in this game!
Commentary.Howout: c Richa Ghosh b Pooja Vastrakar

Commentary.Commentary: Length, outside off. Meg Lanning guides it towards third man for a single.

Tossed up, outside off. Meg Lanning keeps it out.

OUT! CAUGHT! Finally, India Women get the breakthrough! Flatter ball, on a length, around off. Alyssa Healy looks to reverse-sweep but she hits it straight down the throat of Mithali Raj at short third man who takes a sharp catch. Healy departs and Australia Women lose their first wicket. Sneh Rana strikes and this is a much-needed wicket for India.
Commentary.Howout: c Mithali Raj b Sneh Rana

On a length, around off. Rachael Haynes keeps it out.
Flatter ball, outside off. Rachael Haynes cuts it to point.

NOT OUT! Leg bye! A quicker ball, on a length, around middle. Alyssa Healy looks to sweep but she misses and gets hit on her pad. India Women appeal but turned down! Mithali Raj opts for a review but the Ball Tracker indicates that the ball was pitched outside leg. The on-field decision stands.

Another review! India Women once again have opted for a review this time against Alyssa Healy. UltraEdge shows no spike as the ball passes through the bat. Ball Tracker indicates it was pitching outside leg. India Women lose both their reviews.
FOUR! Third boundary off the over! Tossed up, on middle. Alyssa Healy kneels and sweeps it through mid-wicket for another boundary.
Floated, around leg. Alyssa Healy paddles it towards short fine leg.
Jhulan Goswami seems to have hurt her right ankle. The physio is out there to have a check on her. We are set to resume for now!
Wide! Rajeshwari Gayakwad errs in line and serves a wayward ball, down leg. Alyssa Healy misses her flick and the umpire calls it wide.
FOUR! AND AGAIN! A loopy ball, full and on middle. Healy gets down on her knee and sweeps it through the square leg region. The ball races away to the fence.
FOUR! SMASHED! Tossed up, around middle. Alyssa Healy kneels and sweeps it through mid-wicket for a boundary. 100 up for Australia Women!

Review! India Women have reviewed an LBW decision against Rachael Haynes. No bat involved confirms, UltraEdge. Ball Tracker shows that was sliding down leg. The on-field decision stands and India Women lose a review.

NOT OUT! India Women lose a review! This was a quicker ball that goes on with the arm from middle. Rachael Haynes hangs back and looks to play it across the line. She misses and gets hit high on her pad. India Women appeal but the umpire says no. Mithali Raj opts for a review but the Ball Tracker shows that the ball would have missed the leg stump.
Good use of the feet! Floated, full and outside off. Alyssa Healy shimmies down the track and lofts it over the cover fielder for three runs.
Around off, Rachael Haynes eases it to long on for a run.
FOUR! Top shot! This is looped up, on a length, outside off. Haynes skips down the track and carves it past the mid off fielder for a boundary.
Flatter ball, on off. Alyssa Healy mistimes her reverse-sweep towards short third man for a single.
Tossed up, on middle. Alyssa Healy keeps it out on the leg side.

DRINKS! Australia Women have started really well with the bat. India Women have failed to make early inroads and they badly need to break this opening stand, sooner rather than later. The Aussies would be keen to carry on with the momentum and take the game away from India.
Another pitched up delivery, outside off. Rachael Haynes has driven this to the fielder at mid off.
Much fuller now, outside off. Rachael Haynes presses forward and drives it to the fielder at mid off.
Good-length delivery, around middle and leg. Rachael Haynes works it away towards mid-wicket.

Another quick run! Once again, direct-hit would have been the end of Alyssa Healy! On a length, around off. Alyssa Healy taps it towards cover and scampers through to the other end. The fielder has a shy at the bowler's end but misses. That brings up her 50! It's been a great innings from her! She has got Australia Women to a flying start!

An appeal for LBW, but the umpire says no! On a length, angling in, on the pads. Alyssa Healy looks to flick this but she misses and gets rapped on her pad. India Women decide not to take a review here, good decision, that looked like it was too high!
Wide! Meghna Singh drops it short now, around off. Alyssa Healy looks to pull this, but she misses. Wide called for height!
Good-length delivery, outside off. Rachael Haynes opens the face of her bat and guides it towards third man for a single.
Very full again, around middle. Rachael Haynes steps down the pitch and knocks it towards long on for a single. Good start from Sneh Rana, 2 runs off her first over!
Tosses it up, outside off, on a fuller length. Rachael Haynes drives and finds the fielder at cover.
Tad quicker now, full, outside off again. Alyssa Healy taps it towards cover-point and scampers through to the other end.
Slower through the air, full again, around middle. Alyssa Healy leans and blocks it once again.
Full again, outside off. Alyssa Healy presses forward and defends it out.
Sneh Rana begins with a loopy ball, full, outside off. Alyssa Healy looks to drive this but the ball goes off the outside edge towards short third man who collects it on the bounce.
Sneh Rana comes into the attack.
Back of a length, outside off. Alyssa Healy dabs it towards point for a single. She retains the strike!
Full, wide of off. Rachael Haynes drives it uppishly over cover-point for a single.
On a length, angling in, around middle. Rachael Haynes pushes it back to the bowler.
FOUR! Nicely done! On a length, width on offer. Rachael Haynes hangs back and slashes it past point for a boundary.
Good fielding! Fuller ball, outside off. Rachael Haynes drives it towards cover. Pooja Vastrakar dives to her right and makes a good stop.
Wide! Meghna Singh drops it short now, very short on this occasion. This one goes over the batter's head. Wide called for height!
Very full now, outside off. Rachael Haynes squeezes it towards the fielder at point.
Back of a length, outside off. Alyssa Healy waits for it and guides it towards third man for a single.
Full toss now, around off. Alyssa Healy pushes it towards the fielder at mid off.
Tad fuller, outside off. Alyssa Healy dabs it towards the fielder at point.
On a length, around off. Alyssa Healy defends it out.
Tad shorter, around middle. Alyssa Healy pulls it past mid-wicket for a brace.

Quick run! Direct-hit would have been curtains for Rachael Haynes! A fuller ball, around off. Rachael Haynes drives it to the left of mid off, and scampers through to the other end. Harmanpreet Kaur runs to her left, collects the ball with her right hand, and has a shy at the bowler's end but she misses. Single taken!
On a length, on the pads. Rachael Haynes tucks it towards fine leg for a single.
Fuller ball, outside off. Rachael Haynes drives it towards the fielder at cover.
Attacking the stumps, on a length. Rachael Haynes blocks it out.
Good-length delivery, outside off. Rachael Haynes hangs back and looks to cut this away, but she fails to get any bat on it.
Wide! Another length ball, angling away, wide of off. Rachael Haynes lets it go through. Wide given.
Wide! On a length, down the leg side. Rachael Haynes leaves it alone. Wide called!
On a length, on the pads. Alyssa Healy tucks it through square leg for a single.
Tad fuller, around middle. Alyssa Healy defends it out off the front foot.
Time for Powerplay 2! Now, 4 fielders will be allowed outside the circle till the 40th over! Also, Meghna Singh (3-0-21-0) comes back into the attack.
FOUR! No, she doesn't! She serves a length ball, on middle. Rachael Haynes clears her front leg and whacks it over mid-wicket for a boundary.
Full and outside off. Rachael Haynes drives but straight to the cover fielder. Five dots in a row. Can Pooja Vastrakar finish the over well?
On a length, just outside off. Rachael Haynes punches it to the extra cover fielder.
A length ball, around middle. Rachael Haynes defends it back to the bowler.
This is a length ball, around off. Haynes blocks it to cover.
A full ball, on middle. Haynes drives it to the mid on fielder.
Deft touch! Flatter ball, outside off. Alyssa Healy stays back and guides it past Jhulan Goswami at short third man for a couple of runs. 10 runs off the over!
Nicely tossed up, on middle. Healy sweeps it towards square leg. Not in the gap though!
Floated, outside off. Rachael Haynes skips down the track and pushes it to long off for a single.
FOUR! Cut away! Flatter and quicker, outside off. Haynes cuts it through cover and bags a boundary.

Good footwork from Jhulan Goswami in the deep! On a length, around leg. Alyssa Healy paddles it through fine leg. Goswami gives it a chase and keeps the ball in play with some nice footwork. The batters take three runs.
Spin for Rajeshwari Gayakwad! Tossed up, on a length, outside off and spinning away late. Alyssa Healy looks to block but the ball beats her outside edge.
Full and well outside off. Rachael Haynes slices it past point and comes back for the second run.
Good-length ball, around off. Rachael Haynes pushes it to cover.
A direct hit here could have been interesting! On a length, around off. Alyssa Healy blocks it to cover and takes a quick single. The fielder at cover has a shy at the striker's end but he misses.
Good-length delivery, around off. Alyssa Healy defends it to cover.
On a length, around middle. Alyssa Healy tucks it to mid-wicket.
Pooja starts with a full ball, outside off. Alyssa Healy drives it towards the cover fielder.
Pooja Vastrakar comes into the attack.
FOUR! Easy pickings! Tossed up, down leg. Haynes kneels and paddles it through fine leg for a boundary. 50 up for Australia Women in just 7 overs.
Flatter and quicker, around off. Rachael Haynes mistimes her cut to towards cover.
Floated, full and around off. Haynes blocks it.
An overpitched ball, on off. Healy gets forward and pushes it to long on for one run.
Fuller in length, outside off. Haynes works it to long off for a single.
Tosses it up, on middle. Alyssa Healy eases it to long on for a single.
Early change for India Women! It's time for some spin as Rajeshwari Gayakwad comes into the attack now.
On a length, around off. Rachael Haynes defends it onto the deck.
Good-length delivery, just outside off. Alyssa Healy defends it towards point and sets off for a quick single.
Back of a length, around off. Alyssa Healy taps it towards point.
FOUR! Too full and Healy pounces on it! A full ball, outside off. Alyssa Healy prods and carves it through the cover region for a boundary.
Good-length ball, well outside off. Healy does not go chasing for it.
A length ball, shaping away from outside off. Alyssa Healy leaves it alone.
On a length, outside off. Alyssa Healy dabs it towards third man for a single. Another productive over for Australia Women, 9 runs off it.
Angling in, around middle. Alyssa Healy pushes it towards the fielder at mid on this time.
Fuller ball, around off. Alyssa Healy drives and finds the fielder at cover.
FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries! Alyssa Healy is looking in good touch! Jhulan Goswami drops it short now, on middle. Alyssa Healy picks up the length and pulls it past mid-wicket for another boundary.
FOUR! Cracking shot! On a length, around off. Alyssa Healy steps down, walks across, and slaps this past point for a boundary. She moves to 24 off just 16 balls!
On a length, outside off. Alyssa Healy leans and blocks it out.
On a length, outside off. Alyssa Healy opens the face of her bat and guides it towards third man for a single. She retains the strike!
Back of a length, wide of off. Rachael Haynes waits for it and carves it over cover-point. Three taken!
Another length delivery, outside off. Rachael Haynes cuts it straight to the fielder at point.
On a length, around off. Rachael Haynes defends it out off the front foot.

Edged...and away! Much better from Meghna Singh! Tad fuller, around off. Alyssa Healy looks to block this, but the ball goes off the outside edge just away from the first slip fielder towards third man. Single taken!
FOUR! Alyssa Healy is on the charge early in the innings! Fuller ball, outside off. Alyssa Healy leans and carves it over cover for a cracking boundary.
Down the leg side, on a length. Rachael Haynes clips it towards fine leg for a couple of runs.
Good-length delivery, outside off. Rachael Haynes leans and defends it out watchfully.
Back of a length, outside off. Alyssa Healy stays in her crease and dabs it towards third man for a single.
Darting it on the pads, on a length. Rachael Haynes tucks it towards square leg. Single taken!

Angling in, on a length, around middle and leg. Alyssa Healy taps it towards mid-wicket. Shafali Verma runs towards the ball, fumbles, and fails to grab the ball. The batters complete the run comfortably.
On a length, outside off. Alyssa Healy leaves it alone.
Fuller in length, outside off. Alyssa Healy leans and drives it past cover. Three taken!
Pitches it up again, around middle. Alyssa Healy knocks it towards mid on.

Mix-up...but no harm done! Very full this time, outside off. Alyssa Healy digs it out towards the fielder at cover-point, who fumbles a bit. Rachael Haynes leaves her crease as she was looking for a single, but she is sent back in time.
Tad fuller again, around off. Alyssa Healy presses forward and defends it out.
Full again, around middle. Alyssa Healy pushes it towards the fielder at mid on.
FOUR! Meghna Singh starts with a fuller ball, down the leg side. Alyssa Healy clips it fine towards fine leg for a boundary.
Meghna Singh to bowl from the other end.
Fuller again, darting it on the pads. Rachael Haynes tucks it towards fine leg for a brace. 8 runs off the first over!
Fuller now, around middle. Rachael Haynes pushes it back to the bowler.
Good-length delivery, outside off. Alyssa Healy taps it towards point and scampers through to the other end.
FOUR! Alyssa Healy gets off the mark in style! Jhulan Goswami serves a half-volley, outside off. Alyssa Healy presses forward and drives it past cover for a boundary.
Fuller now, angling in, down leg. Rachael Haynes tucks it towards fine leg for a single. Australia Women and Rachael Haynes are up and running!
Jhulan Goswami begins with a length ball, shaping away, outside off. Rachael Haynes cuts it towards point.
